title: Cargo Ships Carry 24,327 Boxes With Smaller Crews
hook: Cargo ships got enormous while their crews shrank.
closing: Your purchases now cross oceans on giant ships run by remarkably small crews.
question: Would you crew one?

segments.say: The largest cargo ship carries 24,327 boxes, moving consumer goods at a scale earlier ships could not match.
The largest cargo ship is 400 meters long, making its physical scale difficult for ports and people to ignore.
A cargo ship crew can be just 20 people, even as the vessels and their economic stakes grew far larger.
